title: Concrete Pump Swing Cylinder Seal Kit Catalogue Sizes
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Swing Cylinder Seal | Pinjin φ60–φ90
description: Pinjin swing / pendulum cylinder seal kits are quote-only sets at φ60, φ70, φ80 and φ90. Confirm the kit on the swing cylinder that switches the S-tube. Not OEM parts of other brands. No list price. No printed hours. Not a main-cylinder seal (those sizes are φ63–100×150 / 461K).

relatedPaths.label: Concrete pump swing cylinder seal product page
Concrete pump S-tube seal kit catalogue sizes

answerBlock.what: Concrete Pump Swing Cylinder Seal is a wear replacement kit supplied by Hebei Pinjin Machinery from Xingtai. Catalogue sizes: φ60, φ70, φ80, φ90. The kit fits the swing / pendulum cylinder that switches the S-tube. Confirm the OD on the cylinder. Quote only; not sold in small batches; no list price; not OEM parts of other pump brands. It is not the main-cylinder seal table.
answerBlock.who: Teams replacing a leaking swing-cylinder kit after matching φ60–φ90 on the cylinder of an S-valve trailer pump.
factors: Works with the S-tube; related S-tube seal and swing-arm ball are other SKUs

faqs.question: Is φ80 swing-cylinder the same kit as the φ80 main-cylinder seal?
faqs.answer: No. Swing-cylinder kits list φ60 / φ70 / φ80 / φ90. Main-cylinder kits list φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. Match the cylinder on the pump.

faqs.question: Does ACPA or SmartBuy set a Pinjin hour for this kit?
faqs.answer: No. SmartBuy lists monthly seal replacement as a generic maintenance bullet. Pinjin does not print swing-cylinder hours. Photograph the leak; send OD and pump model.
